text: DUBAI, May 6 (Reuters) - A senior Iranian parliament member ​said on Wednesday ‌that a report by Axios that includes the ​text of ​a U.S. proposal for an agreement ⁠with Iran to end ​the war was ​more of a wishlist than a reality.

text: May 6 (Reuters) - Iran has not yet responded to the latest U.S. proposal aimed at ending the more than two-month war, Iran's Tasnim news agency said on Wednesday, citing an unnamed source who added that the draft contained some unacceptable provisions.
